dedupeText: 90s r b album cover aesthetic leopard print leather pants 90s r b oversized typography teal and gold trio portrait massive display text overlapping the subjects heads horizontal color block division between white and teal repetitive leopard print patterns across all subjects low angle perspective emphasizing leather boots and seated posture combine subject trio in patterned fashion horizontal color block background top cropped ultra bold display text to recreate the 90s r b aesthetic

retrievalProfile.description: A 90s-inspired music layout featuring a trio in animal prints and leather, anchored by massive, cropped display lettering and a teal-divided background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition featuring three women in coordinated leopard print and black leather attire sitting on a sofa, set against a split background of white and teal, topped with massive, gold-outlined sans-serif lettering that is cropped at the top edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Massive display text overlapping the subjects' heads
Horizontal color-block division between white and teal
Repetitive leopard print patterns across all subjects
Low-angle perspective emphasizing leather boots and seated posture
coreInvariants: Oversized display text must be cropped by the top frame edge
Subjects must wear coordinated animal print and black leather
Background must be split horizontally into two distinct color fields

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects centered, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame in a seated, relaxed pose.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold display text at the top serves as the primary graphic anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large text at the top, down to the faces of the subjects, then following the lines of the leather boots toward the bottom corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with pattern and large-scale graphics.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, earthy tones in the leopard print contrasted with a saturated teal and bright white.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight kerning with overlapping characters
Top of characters are cut off by the canvas edge
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are stretched horizontally to fill the width of the frame
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair massive display sans-serif with small, condensed sans-serif for secondary metadata.
graphicDevices: Sticker-like black rectangle for secondary info

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and vertical presence.
Offers the wide, heavy stance required for the display role.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of three women in leopard print tops and black leather pants sitting on a teal sofa against a white and teal split wall. Leave the top 20% of the image clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-bold, wide sans-serif text in white with a gold outline at the top, ensuring the top of the letters are cropped by the frame edge.

verificationChecks: Is the top text cropped by the frame?
Are the subjects wearing leopard print?
Is there a clear teal and white color split in the background?

postGenerationChecks: Check that text is ultra-bold and cropped at the top.
Ensure leopard print patterns are clear and high-contrast.
Verify the teal and white background division is horizontal.
Confirm the gold outline on the display text is visible.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject Trio in Patterned Fashion] + [Horizontal Color-Block Background] + [Top-Cropped Ultra-Bold Display Text] to recreate the 90s R&B aesthetic.
